nodes.title: The window around a corporate action spans 20 trading days either side
Progress messages fold into run state in sequence order, once each
The heatmap shows exactly the overview's counts, zeros included
A 2-for-1 split is adjusted, and the split day's return is the economic move
A cash dividend scales earlier prices and makes the ex-date total return zero
A reused ticker resolves to two securities and is never spliced
Membership is point in time across two spells
Every exit kind maps to its ExitType, and unknown codes map to OTHER
Deriving the same snapshot twice gives the same fingerprint
A published snapshot is read-only, and a tampered file fails verification by name
An interrupted store leaves no snapshot behind
A download from the synthetic source creates one listed snapshot; a rejected key creates none
A second run of the same kind is refused while one is active
A jump over 40% with no action is flagged; one under 40%, or on a split day, is not
Five equal closes make one stale flag; four make none
A missing trading day and a member without a price are flagged
Adjusted closes more than 0.1% apart are flagged
Cross-check misses over 0.5% are flagged, a missing ticker is "not covered", and the sample repeats
A missing expected fact is reported, never passed
Validating twice gives identical flags and leaves the snapshot unchanged
The report marks out-of-band member counts, lists split moves with the split, and repeats exactly
The ten test companies match their primary-source facts
Pure noise stays inside the Marchenko–Pastur band and denoises to the identity
Three strong planted factors give exactly three eigenvalues above the edge
Removing the market factor leaves residuals nearly uncorrelated
Denoising keeps the trace, the unit diagonal and the signal eigenvalues
Shrinkage intensity is in [0, 1] and matches a reference implementation
The factor model takes k from the spectrum, and a market-only variant
An estimate with a negative eigenvalue is marked failed, never replaced
Every regularised estimate is closer to the truth than the sample estimate
Minimum variance matches the closed form, with and without a binding cap
Risk parity matches inverse volatility where it is exact
HRP splits two uncorrelated equal blocks in half
A construction that does not converge is recorded, not replaced
Every portfolio of a rebalance obeys the shared rules
Changing any return on or after the rebalance date changes no estimate
Rebalances fall on each month's first trading day, over members at the previous close
Eligibility needs 499 of 504 returns; the one-year window needs 247 of 252
The fallback universe is the 100 highest by average traded value
Weights drift through the month, and a delisted name earns zero afterwards
Correlation error needs 126 future days; the bias ratio is 1 when prediction is exact
Months are labelled crisis or calm from the configured periods
A truly lower-variance portfolio is found significantly better
Equal-variance portfolios are almost never called better
The same snapshot and configuration give identical results
The bench passes every known answer on five seeds
The report names its run and holds every section
The Marchenko–Pastur edges match the published closed form
HRP reproduces the paper's published weights
Minimum variance reproduces the paper's long-only CLA weights
Requests from anywhere but the local app are refused
A reconnecting client gets only the events it missed, in order
An ambiguous ticker search returns 409 with every holder
Start a run in its own process
